commit.message:
Generalizing. (#15)

* Updating version of python for Sonar.

* Updating change to facilitate build only occuring on pulls against development branch. (#9)

* Updating sonarqube scanning action per warnings. (#10)

* EKS Setup (#11)

* Adding basline EKS setup.

* Adding Basic Route53 Setup (#12)

* Adding settings for DNS and updating provider settings that have changed.

* Removing unnecessary tags.

* Adding alias for KSK key.

* Adding changes for KMS key setup for DNSSec.

* Correcting KMS key reference.

* Adding sign/verification setup for KMS key for DNSSEC.

* Adding certificate for lab.

* Updating documentation.

* Updating Instance Sizes - EKS (#13)

* Update to the node size.

* Updating second node group size.

* Updating AMI type to conform to new standards.

* Correctingh AMI type.

* Downsizing.

* Removing flag for subdomain.

* Downsizing until requirements met.

* Changing instance types again.

* Correcting AMI type.

* Final update to instance types for now.

* Updating post DNS fix.

* Removing one off item.

* Updating requirements.txt and adding precommit hook.

* Removing unused items from DNS.

* Adding default stubs for value overrides of helm charts.

* Stubbing helm install.

* Added K8S and helm providers to TF to provide an ALB ingress controller to the EKS cluster. Split out the IAM settings into their own separate file for ease of document viewing. Added a base of gitlab settings and helm chart installation for gitlab via helm.

* Fixed command line argument.

* Updating README file.

* Updating install command for helm.

* Small tweak to helm install.

* Updating configuration for https redirection.

* Added a missing IAM permission.

* Small tweak to IAM.

* Adding default storage that was missed initially and updating README.

* Update to policy attachment.

* Minor tweaks to gitlab values.

* Adding peering and updating documentation.

* Testing update.

* Testing start_tls instead of straight ldaps.

* Testing updated values for connectivity.

* Removing certificate verification.

* Removing retry codes.

* Adding final pointer to host.

* Update terraform/irad/main.tf

Co-authored-by: Copilot <175728472+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

* Refactoring some of the IAM.

* Additional refactoring.

* Updating to reduce security impact.

* Further refinement of the resources to remove wildcarding where applicable.

* Generalizing.

---------

Co-authored-by: Copilot <175728472+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
